After misreporting accounting details led to significant financial losses, disciplinary proceedings were initiated against him. The bank's board decided to terminate his employment and pursue recovery of his compensation since March 2020. Concurrently, the bank experienced a return to double-digit growth in loans and deposits. IndusInd's shares have shown recovery, rising by 16% this year.

banking-economy.title: India’s top infrastructure financier plans foray in ABS market
banking-economy.summary: NaBFID is preparing to enter the asset-backed securities market next year as both issuer and investor. The move aims to diversify funding sources and support India's infrastructure finance needs, which are substantial. India's securitization market is growing rapidly, having increased by nearly 42% recently, attracting global investments.
